name: Front Lobby
flavor: Where weary couriers first arrive — and where the chandelier hasn't been dusted in a century.

name: Fragile Wing
flavor: The parcels here weep softly when shaken.

name: Cold Storage
flavor: Frost glitters on every shelf. Some boxes hum back.

name: Intern Pool
flavor: Most never made it home, but they still file paperwork.

name: Review Desk
flavor: Mislabeled parcels get a second opinion here.

name: Incinerator
flavor: Decaying mail ends here. So do most clipboards.

name: Sealed Vault
flavor: The seal on the door predates the postal service itself.

name: Void Chamber
flavor: Ghost mail finally has somewhere to drift.
